specification.title: .3dm File Picker And Options Dialog
specification.goal: File Import selection, preview and options
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Đọc file Rhino .3dm (NURBS/trimmed BRep, layers, units, blocks, meshes), chuyển sang scene OCCT, giao dịch atomic; lệnh Import được gắn qua File Menu Matrix.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không tự xây menu File thứ hai; không cam kết khôi phục userdata proprietary của Matrix/Clayoo.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “.3dm File Picker And Options Dialog” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M03: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “.3dm File Picker And Options Dialog”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.
specification.execution_status: SPEC_ONLY; NOT READY TO CODE UNTIL M00 AND TASK L4 AUDIT

technical_decisions: Xác minh ONX_Model::Read / ON_BinaryFile tại revision openNURBS đã pin trước khi chọn API C++; không suy đoán Rust crate .3dm có sẵn.
Thiết kế bridge Rust↔C++: ownership ONX_Model, memory release, string ABI, exception→Result; không unwind qua extern C.
Bảo toàn object id, layer, units, hidden/locked và warning unsupported; import là một transaction với rollback và metrics trước/sau.
Đối chiếu binary 3DM bằng fixtures nguồn có thể tái lập; báo BLOCKED_FIXTURE nếu thiếu tệp thực; không coi mock JSON là import proof.

input.purpose: File Import selection, preview and options
input.fixture_class: openNURBS V5/V6/V7/V8 synthetic 3dm; source unit in mm/inch; no privileged plugin userdata

positive.setup: Use fixed .3dm fixture with source object IDs, a layer, units and any NURBS trims required by this task.
positive.expected: Preserve count, units, layers and geometry topology at specified tolerances; report transformations and unsupported elements explicitly.

negative.setup: Truncated 3dm input with bad version/chunk, unsupported userdata or invalid trim.
negative.expected: Import aborts atomically or skips explicitly with warnings according to policy; no half-created document.

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.input: Authentic binary .3dm fixture for .3dm File Picker And Options Dialog
golden_test_design.positive_assertions: Compare source openNURBS object table to imported target; explicitly report preservation/loss and hash the fixture.
golden_test_design.negative_assertions: Corrupt binary input must not modify document; no mocked .3dm data.

m03_luna_execution_contract.manual_references_precision: Many references are inherited parent-L2 page ranges, not command-exact citations
invariants: OCCT BRep/Geom is truth for exact geometry; mesh/tessellation only derived
No partial document commit on failure or cancellation
Stable object and subobject identity or explicit broken-reference error
No fabricated test receipts, measured values, or manual review
m03_luna_execution_contract.agent_handoff: Read this L3 first, then precisely one L4 child. Do not start until prerequisite gates and real source available.

focused_test_handoff.source_golden_input_from_parent: Authentic binary .3dm fixture for .3dm File Picker And Options Dialog
focused_test_handoff.parent_golden_positive_oracle: Compare source openNURBS object table to imported target; explicitly report preservation/loss and hash the fixture.
focused_test_handoff.parent_golden_negative_oracle: Corrupt binary input must not modify document; no mocked .3dm data.
focused_test_handoff.independent_domain_example_proposed_not_: real .3dm file(s), versions 5/6/7/8 where supported, with documented units, layer/UUID, NURBS trim inner hole, instance, and unsupported object
domain_specific_assertions_to_select_whe: source .3dm must be real binary and have SHA-256, origin, compatible license
units/tolerance and object/layer IDs map deterministically with loss report
for trimmed face verify p-curves, loop orientations, BRep validity and area
failed read/import leaves document, selection, undo journal and BRep cache unchanged
negative_cases_to_select_when_applicable: malformed header, invalid version, missing surface, open/reversed trim, unknown object
must not silently discard unsupported objects or create partially imported scene

proposed_tolerance_policy_require_local_.geometry_mm_absolute: derived from source doc tolerance and destination tolerance; record effective value
